diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~120% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.376), which favours a weighted combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool6 weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.8237. Series context: trend strength 0.9685 and seasonal strength 0.5566; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.376); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.882.
